hero.title: Design the skills that agro-systemic projects need
hero.description: We design professional training systems adapted to the realities of agro-system professions: competency frameworks, curricula, educational content and assessment tools. Partner training organizations lead the sessions.

distinction.title: Our role:
distinction.text: XP-NOVA designs training systems (frameworks, curricula, content, assessments). Session facilitation, trainer mobilization and participant management are provided by partner training organizations according to our specifications.

services.title: 7 services for quality professional training
services.intro: We support the design of complete training systems, from skills needs diagnosis to learning assessment.

publics.title: 7 audiences for adapted training
publics.intro: Our training systems are designed to meet the needs of various agro-system actors.

cta.title: Does your project need a training system?
cta.subtitle: Our pedagogical engineers support you in the design of frameworks, curricula and content adapted to the realities of the agro-system.
